sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat

findings.why: Heat H-4471 of the partial BR-220 lot has no 3.1 certificate or tensile result in the documents. Drawing Rev C and CP-BR220-R3 require both (Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa, SC-01) before release to production. Someone must supply the certificate and test result for this heat. The source itself is approved: AP-0311 covers Alluminio B for BR-220 at TO1 for STL with 6082-T6. EML-SQ-2026-1105 cites the superseded Rev B (6061-T6, 240 MPa), so it should not be used.
